preconditioning.notes: Page: can be started manually or automatically by setting a fast-charging station as the navigation destination.

capacity_gross_kwh.notes: Toyota Canada release: "a total capacity of 77-kWh" (usable not stated).
Toyota USA release: 74.7 kWh total capacity. Conflicts with Toyota Canada 77 kWh (probably the same pack stated differently).

capacity_usable_kwh.notes: Estimated: C-HR uses the same 74.7 kWh pack as the bZ (Toyota USA C-HR release: 74.7 kWh); EV Database lists 71.0 kWh usable for the 74.7 kWh bZ4X pack. Canada quotes 77 kWh total for the C-HR (probably the same pack, not usable). The 71 kWh is for the 74.7 kWh pack; Toyota Canada / Subaru Canada state 77 kWh total for this car (same-pack assumption unproven), so 71 may be about 3% low if the pack really is 77 kWh.

chemistry.notes: Estimated: C-HR BEV shares the bZ's 74.7 kWh pack (Toyota USA C-HR release); chief engineer: the larger bZ pack 'retains the same chemistry and cells' (NMC).

nominal_voltage_class.notes: Estimated: Shares the bZ's 74.7 kWh pack, 391 V nominal per Autopian; the bZ is a 400 V architecture (InsideEVs).

dc_max_kw.notes: InsideEVs states the C-HR charges at a 150 kW maximum (Toyota figure).

published_10_80_min.notes: "around 30 minutes" under ideal DC fast-charging conditions; model-level claim, not per trim.
